name: Teapot
desc: Plump storybook teapot rocking gently with curling steam ribbons rising from its spout, hand-painted floral sprigs on the belly, a glinting porcelain shine that slides across the glaze, and trim bands on lid and foot. Styles swing from white porcelain to terracotta clay, matte cast iron, carved jade, and a cosmic nebula-glazed pot with violet steam.
